name: Divine Favor

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Bonus Action self; weapon attacks add 1d4 Radiant for one minute; no Concentration; do not attach to unrelated spell damage.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.
